import json, subprocess, sys
def run(data):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(data).encode(),capture_output=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode()), p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()

def base(**kw):
    d={"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[],"priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[],"queries":[]}
    d.update(kw); return d

# 1) threshold equality + witness ties with uniform links
q=[{"id":"eq","path":[1,2,3,4],"threshold":[5,9]},
   {"id":"gt","path":[1,2,3,4],"threshold":[6,10]},
   {"id":"lt","path":[1,2,3,4],"threshold":[4,9]},
   {"id":"zero","path":[1,2,3,4],"threshold":[0,1]},
   {"id":"one","path":[1,2,3,4],"threshold":[1,1]}]
out,rc,err=run(base(queries=q))
for r in out['queries']:
    print(r['id'], r['score'], r['full'], r['witness'], r['leaked'])

# 2) reverse duplicates in rib are distinct observations; ixp in middle
rib=[{"path":[1,2,3],"count":1},{"path":[3,2,1],"count":1},{"path":[1,7,1,2,3],"count":2}]
out,rc,err=run(base(ixps=[7],rib=rib,order=[[1,2],[1,3],[2,3]] if False else [],queries=[]))
print("rib with ixp+reverse ->", json.dumps(out)[:200], rc, err[:200])

# 3) empty everything
out,rc,err=run(base())
print("empty ->", json.dumps(out), rc)

# 4) all records discarded (loops / short)
rib=[{"path":[1,2,1],"count":5},{"path":[9],"count":1},{"path":[],"count":3},{"path":[4,4],"count":2}]
out,rc,err=run(base(rib=rib,order=[],queries=[{"id":"a","path":[1,2,1],"threshold":[1,2]},{"id":"b","path":[4,4],"threshold":[1,2]}]))
print("discarded ->", json.dumps(out))

# 5) declared only (no rib), scoring uses declaration in both directions
d=[{"link":[1,2],"rel":"c2p"}]
q=[{"id":"f","path":[1,2,3],"threshold":[1,2]},{"id":"r","path":[3,2,1],"threshold":[1,2]}]
out,rc,err=run(base(declared=d,queries=q))
print("declared ->", json.dumps(out['queries']))

# 6) prior direction handling
p=[{"link":[2,1],"weights":[1,0,0]}]   # 2->1 is c2p  => canonical (1,2) = p2c
q=[{"id":"x","path":[1,2,3],"threshold":[1,2]},{"id":"y","path":[2,1,3],"threshold":[1,2]}]
